blurb: Experience an exceptional Taos golf course adventure at this stunning 9-hole walking course! Conveniently located just 12 miles from Taos Plaza on picturesque Highway 64, in the heart of the Enchanted Circle. This course offers a unique escape. Surrounded by the breathtaking beauty of Carson National Forest, it’s the ideal destination for both relaxation and recreation.
